mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_Id AS menuId, m.menuName AS menuName, m.menuPrice AS menuPrice, c.menuCategory AS menuCategory FROM MENUS m JOIN MENUC c ON m.menuCategory_Id = c.menuCategory_Id WHERE c.bId = #{bId} ORDER BY m.menu_Id

SELECT m.menu_Id AS menuId, m.menuName AS menuName, m.menuPrice AS menuPrice, f.foodMaterial_Id AS foodMaterialId, f.foodMaterialName AS foodMaterialName, u.usedCount AS usedCount, COALESCE(latest.food_Material_Price, f.foodMaterialPrice) AS foodMaterialPrice, COALESCE(latest.food_Material_Weight, f.foodMaterialWeight) AS totalWeight, ROUND( u.usedCount * ( COALESCE(latest.food_Material_Price, f.foodMaterialPrice) / NULLIF(COALESCE(latest.food_Material_Weight, f.foodMaterialWeight), 0) ), 0 ) AS usedPrice FROM MENUS m JOIN USED u ON m.menu_Id = u.menu_Id JOIN FOODM f ON u.foodMaterial_Id = f.foodMaterial_Id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT food_Material_Name, food_Material_Price, food_Material_Weight FROM purchase WHERE (food_Material_Name, income_Date) IN ( SELECT food_Material_Name, MAX(income_Date) FROM purchase GROUP BY food_Material_Name ) ) latest ON f.foodMaterialName = latest.food_Material_Name WHERE m.menu_Id = #{menuId} ORDER BY f.foodMaterialName ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT u.foodMaterial_Id, SUM(u.usedCount) * #{saleCount} AS requiredCount, f.totalWeight FROM USED u JOIN FOODM f ON u.foodMaterial_Id = f.foodMaterial_Id WHERE u.menu_Id = #{menuId} GROUP BY u.foodMaterial_Id, f.totalWeight HAVING f.totalWeight < requiredCount ) lack
mapper.update: UPDATE FOODM f JOIN ( SELECT foodMaterial_Id, SUM(usedCount) * #{saleCount} AS requiredCount FROM USED WHERE menu_Id = #{menuId} GROUP BY foodMaterial_Id ) u ON f.foodMaterial_Id = u.foodMaterial_Id SET f.totalWeight = f.totalWeight - u.requiredCount WHERE f.bId = #{bId} AND f.totalWeight >= u.requiredCount
mapper.select: SELECT f.foodMaterial_Id AS foodMaterialId, f.foodMaterialName AS foodMaterialName, f.totalWeight AS totalWeight FROM USED u JOIN FOODM f ON u.foodMaterial_Id = f.foodMaterial_Id WHERE u.menu_Id = #{menuId} AND f.bId = #{bId} AND f.totalWeight <= 0 GROUP BY f.foodMaterial_Id, f.foodMaterialName, f.totalWeight
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SALES (menu_Id, saleMenuCount, revenue_Id) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{saleCount}, #{revenueId})
INSERT INTO REVENUE (revenue_Id, bId, revenueDate, payment) VALUES (#{revenueId}, #{bId}, NOW(), #{payment})
mapper.select: SELECT revenue_Id FROM REVENUE ORDER BY revenue_Id DESC LIMIT 1;
